testMessage.title: Send test message
testMessage.hint: Sends this template to one number now, using sample order and customer data. It is charged like any other message.
testMessage.helpTextRecipient: International format is safest, for example +2348030000000. A local number is expanded with the default dial code from the plugin settings.
testMessage.errorUnexpected: The test message could not be sent.

error.templateNotFound: This template no longer exists. Save it first, then try again.
error.templateEmpty: This template has no message text for the selected language.
error.renderFailed: The template could not be rendered. Check the Twig placeholders in the message text.
error.invalidRecipient: That phone number is not usable. Use international format, for example +2348030000000.
error.providerRejected: The provider refused the message. Check the sender ID and credentials in the plugin settings.
error.providerUnavailable: The provider is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
error.missingRecipient: Enter a phone number before sending.
error.errorUnexpected: The test message could not be sent.
error.noProviderConfigured: No provider is configured yet, so nothing was sent. Configure one in the plugin settings.

flowAction.label: Send SMS
flowAction.description: Sends the selected SMS template to the customer's mobile number.

modal.title: Send SMS
modal.hint: Sends the selected template to the customer this flow is about. If the customer has no usable mobile number, the SMS is skipped and the rest of the flow — including the email — still runs.
